title.narrative: Government and social partners in Thailand develop and implement policies to manage migration, protect migrant workers and combat trafficking in line with ILO principles

description.narrative:
The ILO supports the Government and social partners in Thailand to develop and implement policies that promote fair and effective labour migration governance, protect migrant workers, and combat trafficking in line with ILO principles. Through strengthened labour administration and inspection systems, improved regulatory frameworks, and enhanced social dialogue, the programme advances good governance of labour markets and protection at work for all.
While Thailandâ€™s Labour Protection Act applies to all workers, many migrant workers remain more fragile to labour rights violation. Gaps and inconsistencies in the policy setting have effects on the migrant workers access to social security coverage and freedom of association remains a challenge. The ILO continues with its technical intervention and advisory on developing a long-term and coherent legal framework on admission, recruitment, formalization of migrant reliant sectors and protection.
This biennium, the ILO targets to enhance the capacity of constituents remain, especially in promoting the better management of migration and rightsâ€™ protection, through more effective and gender responsive labour inspection, complaints and dispute resolution mechanisms, regulated recruitment practices, skills training and certification.
